title: Package Portal Window by Missed-Visit Fee Record — Appointment Series
content:
Decision table — the span of calendar days from the booking date within which a package portal booking on an Appointment Series counts its standing appointments.

**Rule.** The package portal window is 28 calendar days where the series shows three or more missed-visit fees assessed in the two months up to the booking date (an entry counts when fewer than two whole months separate its date from the booking date), 35 calendar days where it shows one or two such fees, and the booking horizon of the series' format where it shows none; in every case the window still ends no later than the series end date.

**Counted.** Every missed-visit fee entry on the series, whatever its kind, by the date it was assessed.

| Fee entries in the two months up to the booking date | Package portal window |
|---|---|
| three or more | 28 calendar days |
| one or two | 35 calendar days |
| none | the format's booking horizon |

| Visit format | Booking horizon |
|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 42 calendar days |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 42 calendar days |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 42 calendar days |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 28 calendar days |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 56 calendar days |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 42 calendar days |

**Edges (hypothetical).** Two fee entries give 35 days and a third gives 28 days. Booking on 18 May: an entry dated 19 March counts, one dated 18 March does not.
